description: Railway bridge cable data is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors LUIS ADOLFO CHILLITUPA PALOMINO (Universidad Politécnica de Madrid). Data used on the article: Decision-tree-based models for robust tension force estimation in cables with non-negligible bending stiffness under natural-frequency uncertainty. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. Formats: TXT, PDF. Size stated: 1696827. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
